steps.prompt: A hot-air balloon with a round puffy envelope made of sixteen vertical gores in alternating red, cream, cobalt blue, golden yellow, magenta and mint, a brass burner ring, ropes down to a small woven wicker basket. Photograph of a real glossy designer vinyl art-toy collectible, smooth sculpted soft-vinyl and lacquered resin surfaces, saturated candy paint colours with real paint drips, crisp studio product lighting, high detail. Single isolated object, the entire object in frame with margin, centered, three-quarter front view from slightly above, even soft studio lighting, no cast shadow, plain light-grey seamless background. No text, no logos, no lettering, no numbers, no brand marks, no emblems anywhere on the object.
